description: Certificate of Lawfulness (Existing) to confirm the use of the first, second and third floor of 49 Florence Street as a self contained, three bed flat.
decision_conditions:
The following documents were submitted with this application. 

External streetscene front elevation photograph (undated); kitchen and dining room photograph (undated); bathroom photograph (undated); lounge photograph (undated); carpet order confirmation (1 August 2025); renovation schedule for entire dwelling (10 April 2025); invoice for plumbing works carried out at 49 Florence Street on 10 May, 31 August, 1 September and 10 September (all 2023); Council Tax bill for 2023-2024; Council Tax bill for October 2022 – March 2023 ; Exchange of emails between New Unity CIO and the London Borough of Islington concerning the non-payment of Council Tax; Council Tax bill for 2021-2022 (reference to 49 Florence Street); Council Tax bill for 2020-2021 (reference to 49 Florence Street); Redacted bank statement showing payment on 11 March 2026 ; Tenancy Agreement (Jan 2026) for an unspecified period; emails to and from letting agents (Chestertons, March 2026); bank account statement suggesting receipt of rental income (October 2025); Tenancy agreement (October 2025); addendum to tenancy agreement confirming that the occupier will pay the provider compensation for utility fees (September 2025); electrical installation condition report for 49 Florence Street (NIC, 22/9/2025); EPC (23/09/2025) (Reference made to ground floor flat); Confirmation of furniture order to the applicant’s name at 49 Florence Street (17/09/2025); Letter concerning fire safety arrangements with reference made to a flat at 49 Florence Street (02/07/2018);
